measurement: One fresh Node child per implementation with --expose-gc. Input constructed before explicit GC; compare heapUsed immediately before and after one token estimate without GC after the call. Heap delta includes collectible temporaries; it is not peak or retained heap. Local wall timing excludes startup and input construction.
regression: 4 MiB ASCII estimation plus budget trimming succeeds in a fresh Node child with --max-old-space-size=64.
